classificationDefinitions.A: Executable without a production write, customer data, public DNS, paid service, destructive action, or new owner decision
classificationDefinitions.C: Cannot close until a defined elapsed-time or predecessor observation window completes
classificationDefinitions.D: Requires a paid service or an approved increase to an existing cost ceiling

gates.gate: AWS-native image deployed to ECS staging and healthy with no Supabase/Brevo runtime configuration
gates.dependency: Final AWS staging database and cost authority

gates.gate: Private managed AWS PostgreSQL staging target, schema, roles, verified TLS, secret rotation and automated backups
gates.dependency: Paid RDS/Aurora target exceeds current 75 USD staging ceiling

gates.gate: All server read repositories converted from PostgREST/Supabase to parameterized PostgreSQL
gates.dependency: Engineering only; qualification-history slice and pool foundation complete

gates.gate: All server mutations and RPC workflows converted to atomic PostgreSQL transactions
gates.dependency: Engineering only

gates.gate: AWS PostgreSQL data parity, load, tenant-negative and timed backup/restore acceptance
gates.dependency: Gate 2 target

gates.gate: Cognito login, callback, refresh, logout and durable session composition activated in the application
gates.dependency: Engineering only; disabled protocol and persistence foundations are reusable

gates.gate: Synthetic Cognito lifecycle, tenant/RLS and revocation parity on the AWS-native staging runtime
gates.dependency: Gates 1 and 2

gates.gate: Production-user Cognito migration, password activation, MFA and communication policy executed
gates.dependency: Owner approval for user-facing production identity changes

gates.gate: Browser data calls moved behind authenticated server APIs and auth.uid()/SECURITY DEFINER behavior replaced safely
gates.dependency: Engineering only

gates.gate: Service-role bypasses, Supabase key fallbacks and Supabase packages removed from final runtime source
gates.dependency: Engineering only; dedicated importer/session/database secret composition is complete

gates.gate: Static and runtime zero-Supabase dependency, credential and egress gate passes
gates.dependency: Gates 3, 4, 6, 9 and 10; fail-closed AWS-native startup tuple is complete

gates.gate: Synthetic S3 object, metadata/reference, checksum, signed-access, orphan and version-restore parity
gates.dependency: Engineering only; private versioned S3 provider and prior synthetic copy/restore are reusable

gates.gate: Production Supabase Storage objects copied to S3 and reconciled before authority switches
gates.dependency: Owner approval for customer object movement

gates.gate: Production RDS/Aurora topology, credentials, networking and automated backup/PITR deployed
gates.dependency: Owner architecture, cost, RPO and production-write approval

gates.gate: Production database rehearsal and final customer-data copy complete with manifests and reconciliation
gates.dependency: Owner approval for production data movement

gates.gate: Production write-freeze/CDC choice, application switch, acceptance and rollback thresholds executed
gates.dependency: Owner cutover-window and production-change approval

gates.gate: Supabase rollback observation window completes, then credentials, egress, projects and recovery dependency are removed
gates.dependency: Successful production cutover plus owner-approved observation duration

gates.gate: SES production delivery, feedback suppression worker and a human operational alert endpoint are active
gates.dependency: No suitable existing unsuppressed operational mailbox is evidenced; owner must identify one or wait for the current suppression window before separately authorizing email changes

gates.gate: AWS database/S3 recovery objectives, alarms and timed disaster-recovery proof satisfy approved RPO/RTO
gates.dependency: Paid production data services and owner-selected RPO/RTO/retention

gates.gate: GovCloud portability configuration, partition-safe IAM/ARNs, mirrored artifacts and GovCloud-compatible synth pass
gates.dependency: Engineering only for commercial-partition portability proof; live GovCloud deployment requires an account

gates.gate: Public DNS/traffic cutover to AWS certificates and ALB completes with rollback window
gates.dependency: Owner production DNS and traffic approval
